description: This header file defines the Biquad class, which implements a digital filter component for audio or signal processing. It declares the class, its constructor, initialization, processing methods, and filter coefficients.

classes.name: Biquad
classes.description: A class representing a biquad digital filter with methods for initialization and processing signal inputs. It maintains filter coefficients and delay states.
